verdict.rationale: The docs say OCR works 'even from low-quality or handwritten sources' and offer confidence scores at page, block or word level. Annotation formats let developers pull structured fields. A community user reports high accuracy digitizing handwritten forms, with only a small share needing human review. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of handwriting recognition (it is only a one-line mention), any explicit evidence on handwritten annotations or marginalia as distinct from forms, and a documented built-in mechanism for flagging uncertain results rather than raw scores alone.
